messages.author: 39ae60762c088189
messages.subject: Re: Is this active?
parts:
Ha! That's indeed not very impressive. Although it was a very visual demonstration of being able to run an R interpreter in GAE, it was also a toy example which we haven't maintained in years and it looks like something finally broke it! We'll see if we can fix that, but it is certainly not a priority for us.

Running a CLI in a browser window is not a typical use-case for Renjin. In most cases, you will want to have Renjin inside your web application, ready to calculate something that is expressed in the R programming language. Have a look at https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin-examples/tree/master/appengine-servlet to get a web app running with just a few commands on a local instance of the GAE SDK.

Maarten-Jan
